TWENTY-FOURTH CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA
THIRD REGULAR SESSION, 2026 CONGRESSIONAL BILL NO. 24-114
P.C. NO. 24-235 PUBLIC LAW NO. 24-64
AN ACT
To further amend Public Law No. 22-180, as amended by Public Laws
Nos. 22-187, 22-188, 23-03, 23-09, 23-11, 23-36, 23-59, 23-118,
23-124, 23-139, 23-145, 24-16 and 24-19, by amending sections 4
and 6 thereof, for the purpose of changing the use, allottee and
lapse date of funds previously appropriated therein, to fund
public projects and social programs for the people of Yap, Kosrae,
Pohnpei, and Chuuk States, and for other purposes.
